notes.title: Update: Left-Handed Mode & More Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
I've just added an input swap option to make things more comfortable for left-handed players. You’ll find the button to activate left-handed mode right in the physical menu in the starting room, just as usual. 
This update also brings a few minor visual improvements and performance tweaks.

V 1.02 Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Left-handed mode / input swap option added
[*] Fixed LOD issues (no more pop-ins!)
[*] General performance enhancements
[*] Updated credits
[/list]

If you run into any bugs or issues, please share them here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3103480/discussions/1/4632609289965463733/

And as always, I’m excited to hear your feedback!

Best,
Hermann

notes.title: Preparing for Release: Heart-Lung Machine Releases Nov 11
notes.notes:
I’m excited to announce that Heart-Lung Machine will officially release on November 11, 2024! A massive thank you to all the dedicated playtesters who helped shape it into the experience it is today.

I’ll be patching heavily over the weekend to address recent beta feedback, making sure everything’s ready for Monday. In the meantime, check out the new trailer to see what you’re in for:

[previewyoutube=1cuv9Q8s14g;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope to see you here on release day!

Best,
Hermann
